protocol.head: LayerNorm(1536), Dropout(0.1), Linear(1536,6)
protocol.pooling: Final hidden-state frame mean and sqrt(population variance + 1e-5), concatenated
protocol.training_input: One uniformly sampled contiguous 5-second crop per official-train recording per epoch
protocol.waveform_normalization: Per-window zero mean and divide by sqrt(variance + 1e-7)
protocol.inference: Six fixed non-overlapping five-second windows covering all 30 seconds; mean of six logits, microbatch 2
protocol.selection: Stratified 20% internal holdout drawn only from official train; maximize Top-1 + 0.5 * Top-3, tie Top-1 then earliest epoch
protocol.final_refit: Reset original pinned pretrained weights and fresh seeded head; fit all official train for exactly the selected epoch count
protocol.official_validation: Final reporting only. Its earlier frozen-baseline results were already observed; no fine-tuning setting or submission model is chosen from the official validation results.
protocol.submission_choice: Use the user-requested fine-tuned model for each task regardless of its validation comparison with the frozen baseline
protocol.augmentation: Random temporal crop only; no pitch shift, time stretch, source separation, or extra labeled audio
protocol.resume: Atomic completed-epoch checkpoints; seed 2026 + epoch resets shuffle, crop, and dropout RNG
